title: Agent identity
description: Logical identity and declared capabilities of an AI agent (spec/01-agent-identity.md). Stable across deployments; does not identify a model, prompt, or deployment instance.

id.description: Producer-chosen absolute URI naming the logical agent. tag: URIs (RFC 4151) are recommended when the producer has no other naming authority.

version.description: Producer-defined version of the logical agent. Semantic Versioning is recommended.

owner.description: Accountable team or organization. Not a personal contact address.

runtime.description: Execution runtime or hosting environment class (e.g. "aws-bedrock", "on-prem").

risk_class.description: Producer-declared risk class. Values are producer-defined until assurance profiles are standardized.

tools.description: Tools the agent is permitted to invoke, with the scopes it is granted.

external_ids.description: Identifiers for this agent in other systems (inventories, GRC platforms, registries).
